plugin.name: CODECHECK
plugin.summary: Integrates the CODECHECK process for checking the computational reproducibility of research into submission, editorial workflow and publication.
plugin.description:
Integrates CODECHECK into OJS: authors opt in and name their code and data repositories at submission, editors and codecheckers record the check and its status in the workflow, publication can be held until the check is complete, and published articles show a CODECHECK badge, the certificate and a data and software availability statement.

The plugin contacts external services. It opens and updates issues in the CODECHECK register and proposes register.csv entries on GitHub, using a personal access token that is stored in the plugin settings, and it can deposit peer-review activity to codecheckers' ORCID records.
plugin.installation: Enable the plugin under Settings > Website > Plugins, then configure it in the plugin's settings: the CODECHECK register repository and personal access token, ORCID, and what is shown to readers.

release.description: First release in the Plugin Gallery.
